description: Ferry routes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. The Department of Transport and Main Roads contracts with ferry operators and is responsible for the provision of services between these centres:- Palm Island to Townsville- Magnetic Island to Townsville- Thursday Island to Seisia- Coochiemudlo Island to Victoria Point- North Stradbroke Island to Cleveland- Southern Moreton Bay Islands (Russell Island, Macleay Island, Karragarra Island and ... Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are STAS, ferry, public transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, TAB, FGDB, KMZ, GPKG, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
